user_saw: Control UI chat and agent events could show an old parent session or omit the current parent after a session changed.
summary: The fix replaces the gateway’s permanent lineage cache with reads from the current prepared session projection and incognito store metadata.
reasoning: The gateway already cached both parent values and misses indefinitely at the shallow boundary. I checked the dashboard eligibility change and the later prepared-read change, which both retained that cache. Older path history stopped at a missing object, so I could not verify when the cache was introduced or whether session lifecycle changes first exposed the stale results.
